text:
```yaml
name: Check Discord Invite Link

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */12 * * *'   # every 12 hours
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check-discord-link:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Check Discord invite health
        run: |
          CODE="f2AjwV2AN"
          URL="https://discord.com/api/v10/invites/${CODE}"
          HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "$URL")
          if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" -ne 200 ]; then
            echo "Discord invite is broken (status $HTTP_STATUS)"
            OWNER_REPO=${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}
            # Check for existing open issue with label 'discord-link'
            ISSUES_JSON=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/${OWNER_REPO}/issues?state=open&labels=discord-link")
            if echo "$ISSUES_JSON" | grep -q "\"discord-link\""; then
              echo "An open issue with label 'discord-link' already exists. Skipping."
              exit 0
            fi
            # Create a new issue
            TITLE="Discord invite link is broken"
            BODY="The Discord invite link \`discord.gg/f2AjwV2AN\` returned status $HTTP_STATUS. Please investigate."
            curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
              -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
              -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
              -d "{\"title\":\"$TITLE\",\"body\":\"$BODY\",\"labels\":[\"discord-link\"]}" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/${OWNER_REPO}/issues"
          else
            echo "Discord invite is healthy."
          fi
```
